svg.title: Beaumont and San Gorgonio Pass four-era mural timeline
svg.desc: An editable 1:10-scale, 5-degree timeline for twenty approved historical events, styled from the visible artwork in timeline-module-master-v2. Each event has a serif year and headline above the line and a unified photo-caption matte below it. The line is divided into four eras.
svg.metadata: Production scale is 1:10; enlarge the placed art to 1000% for the 356in by 120in mural. The viewBox retains full-size inch coordinates. The timeline descends 5 degrees from left to right. All headline, photo and caption tiles remain level like escalator steps. Every photo-caption module center is 11.06 full-size inches vertically below the line. Visible styling is derived from timeline-module-master-v2 artwork; its written spec annotations were not used. Photos are intentionally omitted. Replace the solid matte inside each group named photo-placeholder-XX in Adobe Illustrator.
